highlights: Trained and evaluated supervised and unsupervised models on real datasets as part of a structured AWS Academy track.
Raised prediction accuracy by about 15% through feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning in Python and AWS SageMaker.

projects.name: Askfolio
highlights: Built a streaming chat app where recruiters ask about Sandeep's background and get answers drawn only from a portfolio data file, deployed on Streamlit Community Cloud.
Wrote refusal rules into the system prompt so the model says it has no information rather than guessing, and tested it against skills and employers absent from the data.

Kept all portfolio content in a runtime-read JSON file and split UI from model logic, so updating experience needs no code change; capped response tokens and history length to control usage on a public endpoint.

projects.name: JobSync
projects.tagline: AI Resume Screening & Job Matching Platform
highlights: Built a screening tool that ranks multiple candidate resumes against a pasted job description, returning a fit score, matched and missing skills, and a written verdict per candidate.
Used Pydantic schemas with JSON-mode prompting on Groq so the model returns typed, validated fields instead of free-form text.
Parsed PDF and DOCX resumes with pypdf and python-docx, isolating failures per file and adding retry with backoff so one bad file never breaks a batch run.
Built a Streamlit dashboard with dark and light theming, session analytics, and an exportable print-ready report.

projects.name: IPL Data Analysis & Visualization
projects.tagline: Exploratory data analysis on IPL match and ball-by-ball data
highlights: Cleaned and merged 756 IPL matches and 179,000+ ball-by-ball records from 2008 to 2019, handling missing values and standardizing team names across seasons.
Flagged outliers with the IQR method, then pulled out patterns in top scorers, wicket-takers, and team scoring across overs.
Built 10+ Seaborn and Plotly visualizations covering powerplay and death-over trends, toss impact, and venue and season patterns.

projects.name: AutoElite
highlights: Built a responsive car dealership site with real-time search, multi-criteria filtering, sorting, and a favorites shortlist over a structured JS dataset.
Wrote event-driven JavaScript for dynamic card rendering and a modal login flow, keeping markup, styling, and logic in separate files.
